name: RITES
purpose: Compose human continuity, lifecycle, relationship and transition capabilities while preserving canonical identity, consent, authority and provenance.
authority_model: Relationship and continuity state does not create authority; consent, representation and mandate remain explicit.
data_model: Identity, relationship, lifecycle, event and evidence records with provenance and temporal context.
evidence_model: Observed facts, claims, records and derived interpretations remain distinct.
economic_model: May carry economic obligations and relationships but does not replace Value or settlement semantics.
pulse_model: Continuity outcomes may emit canonical feedback and learning signals.
continuity_model: Continuity is primary; records and obligations remain transferable across product replacement.
exit_handoff: Transfer active lifecycle state, relationships, obligations, evidence and authority context to the canonical receiving environment.
